Read 👎 When to use A problem card about cold outreach that gets ignored or messages left on read Bento grids and feature cards that need a small illustration above the text When not to use A real chat UI – the bubbles are a fixed, decorative scene Very small sizes below ~220px wide, where the bubble text gets hard to read Installation Add Ghosted Chat with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19.
